title: Field
description: One glossary field definition, as recorded in the Knowledge Hub. Interfaces reference fields by field_id rather than redefining them.

field_id.description: Unique kebab-case field key, e.g. order-status

format.description: Format hint, e.g. ISO-8601, or a pattern template

status.description: General business rule for this field, independent of any one interface

source_system.description: System of record / data owner for this field

quality_rules.description: Data quality / validation rules for this field
